content: Ibn Turka names three ways of pursuing the science successfully: (1) dealing with the realities behind the forms of the letters that make up the names of things; (2) dealing with both the form and the meaning of the letters; (3) attaining the inner essence of realities by numerology (ʿilm-i aʿdād), which is peculiar to ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib, who received it through the Prophetic legacy. The work is intended to encompass all three.
